comments.author: @johntomasik1555
comments.text: 17:48  Now that's a Taiwanese person.  Everyone is so friendly and cool.  Personally, I avoid the big, "famous" restaurants.   I love the small restaurants and the local popular restaurants much more.  I am kinda surprised there aren't more videos of the food offered by the small restaurants.  It isn't simply night market food, beef noodle soup, and stinky tofu.  There are dozens if not hundreds of Taiwan dishes the local restaurants and vendors offer that are equally, if not more, amazing than the typical stuff shown on these vids.
